```{r}
round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#order is from to by
print(seq(1,10,2))
print(seq(by = 2, from = 1, to = 10))
```
```{r}
#order is x, times
print(rep(2,5))
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(times = 7, x = 5))
```

```{r}
x <- 1
y <- "hello"
z <- TRUE
print(x)
print(y)
print(z)
print(class(x))
print(class(y))
print(class(z))
```

```{r}
ID1 <- "CX1"
ID2 <- "CX2"
treat1 <- TRUE
treat2 <- FALSE
numb1 <- 5415
numb2 <- 8123
numa1 <- 1432
numa2 <- 7543
```

```{r}
library(fortunes)
fortune()
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}
ID <- c(ID1, ID2)
numb <- c(numb1, numb2)
treat <- c(treat1, treat2)
numa <- c(numa1, numa2)
```

```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
fourth <- all_my_pets[4]
print(fourth)
```

```{r}
cell_data_frame <- tibble(
cell_id = ID,
treated = treat,
num_cells_before = numb,
num_cells_after = numa,
)
print(cell_data_frame)
gt(cell_data_frame)
```
```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
```

```{r}
gt(weather)
```
```{r}
ggplot(weather)
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
))
```

```{r}
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line()
```
```{r}
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp (C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```
